ranked_causes.issue: PipelineCache prediction key collision in replay
ranked_causes.estimated_impact: Phase 27A replay served one cached ML signal for ~5201 bars (decision_ms=0 on 5200/5203). Hold-chain RSI counters replayed from stale _hold_chain payload — not per-bar fresh evaluation.
ranked_causes.recommended_fix: Use candle timestamp in prediction cache key; do not modify in Phase 27B.

ranked_causes.issue: RSI mid-band filter rejects majority of fresh actionable signals

ranked_causes.recommended_fix: Re-certify RSI band on XAUUSD M5 RANGE regime; hold-chain should record ADX separately when both fail.

ranked_causes.issue: Hold-chain attributes dual RSI+ADX failures to RSI only
ranked_causes.estimated_impact: Under-counts ADX filter impact in Phase 27A hold_analysis.
ranked_causes.recommended_fix: Record primary and secondary block reasons in hold chain diagnostics.
